brief: The canvas simulates a retro-style terminal console displayed on a dark background. Bright green or amber text streams across the screen, appearing to type out and scroll down rapidly, simulating the output of a complex, mysterious program running in the background. A blinking text cursor remains visible at the end of the output stream, suggesting active computation. There are no visible shapes or color changes apart from the continuous stream of text and the cursor's flicker. The simulation runs independently, generating continuous text output without requiring any interaction from the user.

prompt: use text to simulate a terminal console running a mysterious computer program
statement: This sketch simulates a retro terminal console with bright green text streaming across a dark background. The simulation generates continuous output by adding new lines of pseudocode at regular intervals, mimicking the behavior of a complex program running in the background. A blinking cursor appears at the end of the output stream to suggest active computation. The text uses a monospace font for authentic terminal appearance and cycles through various debug prefixes and processing commands. The display maintains only a fixed number of lines to prevent memory buildup while continuously producing new content that scrolls upward, creating an immersive effect of ongoing system activity.
